messages:
Maya: t-minus 15 to EU change window start. quick handoff — Maya will stay till +30. @Jorge you OK to own rollback if canary spikes? :eyes:
Jorge: I can own rollback. will be online and watching metrics. ping me if error rate > 2% or latency > 450ms.
Olivia: I have the canary smoke script running now, logs are green. linking release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2.14.0 — small model config updates, embeddings cache tweak.
Samir: FYI feature-flag `new-routing-v2` is off in prod; canary will run against routing-v1 -> we agreed on conservative path. if we need to toggle, Samir on toggle.
DeployBot: deploy request accepted: release/2.14.0 -> eu-prod. Canary group: 3% -> 10% at +10m -> 25% at +20m. Canary timeout: 3m.
Maya: good. checklist quick: 1) smoke OK (Olivia) 2) metrics dashboard up (Jorge) 3) rollback owner set (Jorge) 4) infra alerts armed (InfraBot) 5) release notes link shared (Olivia) 6) approvers present (Maya)
Olivia: smoke output snippet: ```smoke: PASS
latency_p50: 120ms
error_rate: 0.0%```
InfraBot: alerts armed: cpu/latency/error-rate SLO alerts to #eng-oncall and Jorge. Canary escalation policy set to page on major and post to thread on minor.
Jorge: watching dashboards. added a quick grafana panel for embeddings-queue-depth. will watch memory > 78%.
DeployBot: Canary step 1 complete: 3% traffic routed. Observability: no anomalies in first 60s. Next ramp scheduled in 9m.
Maya: thumbs up. keep note — if we see token-cost-per-request spike > 30% compared to baseline, consider immediate rollback.
Samir: noted. infra had a small GC blip earlier in staging but looked fine after bumping `jvm.heap` 200m. I have a rollback play: `deploybot rollback release/2.14.0 --to release/2.13.7` (manual confirmation required).
Jorge: small uptick on p95 at +6m to 510ms, watching. error rate still 0.1%. hold on further ramps until p95 stabilizes <500ms.
DeployBot: Canary ramp paused by Jorge per request. next ramp canceled. Waiting for manual resume.
Olivia: reran smoke with full embed set, still green. suspect temporary noisy neighbor. logs show a couple of retries from an edge host in eu-west-3.
Maya: decision: keep pause for now. Jorge will clear to resume when p95 back under 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes. if not, we'll rollback. everyone acknowledge? :white_check_mark:
Jorge: acknowledge and will post resume call.
Samir: acknowledge. ready to toggle flag or rollback.
DeployBot: Canary still at 3%. Awaiting resume command.
Maya: I'll leave thread open and tag oncall after +30 if no change. thanks all — great coordination.
InfraBot: NOTE: post-deploy housekeeping checklist: update changelog in docs, tag the canary metrics snapshot, and rotate temporary monitoring credentials.
Olivia: putting a short release note blurb in #release-notes and will follow up with customer-impact blurb if we fully roll.
Jorge: resume approved — p95 back to 470ms after 3 checks. resuming canary ramp to 10% now.
DeployBot: Ramp to 10% initiated. Will report back after 2m health window.
Maya: perfect. I'll be around until +30. if anything odd, DM me directly.
DeployBot: Canary complete: 10% stable, no alerts. scheduling 25% ramp in 9m.
Maya: if 25% stable, we'll call it a successful launch and flip release notes to GA. Great job. :tada:
